{ "rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment turns negative to match slower price recovery",
    "Increase forecast amplitude when sentiment strength is extreme (above 0.67 or below -0.67)",
    "Apply mean reversion correction when forecast deviates more than 2 from recent mean",
    "Lag sentiment-based forecast adjustments to match actual price reaction speed",
    "Scale back overconfident forecasts when true outcomes show more volatility than predicted",
    "Correct directional bias when sentiment and price momentum diverge significantly",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude when prices are at or near historical extremes"
] }
